heparin and its derivatives can effectively modulate multiple components of the thrombosis, inflammation, angiogenesis and metastasis pathways.
heparin can be used for the treatment and prevention of thromboembolism and other multi-factorial diseases.

the discovery of novel antithrombotic and anti-inflammatory drugs.
the development of new heparin-based drugs for the management of various thromboembolic and inflammatory disorders.
the discovery of novel heparin-based agents that will provide new therapeutic options for the treatment of thrombo-embolic disorders and beyond.

the use of heparin and its derivatives will be extended to several new indications, and the use of hepa-rins will be expanded to several new indications.

heparin is a polypharmacologically potent agent with a wide spectrum of pharmacological effects.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

heparin is a multi-factorial drug that can be used for the prevention and/or treatment of multi-factor diseases such as cancer, inflammation, thromboembolic and other cardiovascular diseases, and even diabetes and obesity (5-7).
heparin, LMWHs, and other heparin-related drugs are the most effective and safe agents for the management of various thromboembolic diseases.

heparin and LMWHs have multiple sites of actions.

the heparin family of drugs can be used for the management of a variety of diseases, including cancer, and that heparin is a polypharmacologic agent that can be used in a wide range of clinical indications.
